integrity: The GMRES iterates are reconstructed from their defining normal equations. The field-of-values boundary follows from the exact path-adjacency spectrum, and the coordinate sign boundary follows from closed rational formulas. The packaged checker independently replays the rational witness and formula identities.
scientific_limitations: The exact positivity boundary is proved only for the explicit four-state family A_t=I-tS with b=(1,2,2,1)^T, zero initial guess, exact arithmetic, and unrestarted GMRES. No universal M-matrix threshold, minimal-dimension theorem, or later-iterate classification is claimed.
title: GMRES loses positivity before the field-of-values boundary in a four-state M-matrix family
